n: Major and Local Community Infrastructure Program
ag: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts
agencies: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts
recipients: The Council of the Municipality of Kiama
Whittlesea Showgrounds and Recreation Reserves Committee of Management

grants.n: The project will deliver the construction of the Bacchus Marsh Aquatic Centre comprising an aquatic pool hall including change facilities and kiosk/servery area and health and fitness facilities.

The project will deliver construction of a new facility including changerooms, kiosk, first aid room, outdoor heated pools, leisure water area, seating and viewing areas, plant and chemical storage room, shading, lighting, car park and landscaping.
The project will deliver a hybrid turf playing field and public amenities at Casey Fields Sports Precinct.
The project will deliver the construction of the new three-storey Southern Suburbs Community Centre and Library, including amenities, office spaces, kitchen/café, learning spaces, and auditorium.

The project will deliver the design and construction of the Canning Vale Sports Complex, including natural turf sporting fields, new clubroom and changeroom building, storage, lighting and carparking.

The project will deliver the redevelopment of the Kogarah War Memorial Pool, commonly known as the Carss Park Pool. Works will include a new ancillary building, a 50m outdoor pool, and a 20m outdoor Learn to Swim pool.
The project will deliver the design and construction of four new parks for Fairfield, with inclusive, age-appropriate equipment, informal recreation areas, and public amenities, where applicable.
The project will deliver the redevelopment of the Girrawheen Hub, including construction of a new library, and a combined senior centre and community hub.

The project will deliver two competition-compliant courts with lighting, run-off areas and line marking. It will also construct a dedicated warm-up and shooting area and redevelop the ageing amenities building.
The project will deliver a new, purpose-built two-storey pavilion to include four change rooms, amenities, umpire rooms, first aid room, kiosk, cool room, and dedicated internal and external storage.

The project will deliver the design, construction and upgrade of the Saltwater Reserve Community Sporting Hub. Stage 1 - New Changeroom Pavilion and Stage 2 - Upgrade of the existing Pavilion and including external works.

The project will deliver Stage 1 of the Active Open Space redevelopment at Devlins Road Reserve including the construction of a full-size natural turf soccer pitch, a multipurpose pavilion and a car park.

The project will deliver upgrades to Coleman Park, including construction of a playspace and informal recreation facilities, including outdoor fitness equipment, and construction of a multi-purpose sports court.
The project will deliver the construction of a play space with a giant Murray Cod climbing/play structure and various play equipment, furniture, artworks, lighting and landscaping.
The project will deliver the remaining design, and construction works for Stages 2a and 2c at the Belmont Sports Complex.
The project will deliver the construction of a roof structure to cover outdoor courts and resurface the existing courts and install safety barriers, seating and compliance equipment.

The project will deliver the construction of footpaths, play equipment, public amenities, sport and recreation infrastructure, gathering spaces, picnic and BBQ area, lighting, signage, landscaping and car parking.

The project will deliver a new enclosed pool and a new clubhouse/recreation facility at the Lowood Swimming Pool, including associated infrastructure, improved disability access, and demolition of the existing clubhouse.

The project will deliver upgrades to the Mandurah Aquatic and Recreation Centre, expanding the existing building to include 3 additional indoor multi-use courts with associated amenities and new spectator seating.

The project will deliver the redevelopment of Windsor Park with lighting over two new netball courts, new cricket nets, improvements to the main pavilion, vehicle and pedestrian access, open space and ancillary sporting infrastructure.
The project will deliver the upgrade of Sparks Reserve West soccer field, including replacement of the existing natural turf with synthetic, new lighting and improved pedestrian access.
The project will deliver a new two storey surf lifesaving club to include administration office, change room facilities, storage areas, lift, gym, members lounge, kitchen, bar and outdoor deck area.
The project will deliver upgrades to the historic A.R. Glenn Grandstand, sports field lighting and build new unisex netball changerooms with toilets at Gillon Oval, Brunswick.

The project will deliver multi use facilities including; a new playground, soccer pavilion and toilet upgrades, sports ground lighting, a bus shelter, BBQ area, car parking, bike and walking loop, landscaping and other supporting infrastructure.

The project will deliver the upgrade of Wallsend's Upper Reserve, including enhanced utility infrastructure, playing surface upgrades for upper fields 1 to 6, and resurfacing and linemarking on the existing car park.
The project will deliver upgrades to sports fields lighting at Church Road, Moss Vale and David Wood Playing Fields, Bowral, and a children's play area at Hampden Park, Robertson.

The project will deliver the design and construction of a new sports amenity facility including a modular building with changerooms, umpires and officials' amenities, kiosk, first aid room, storage and supporting external infrastructure.

The project will deliver the design and construct a purpose-built community and sporting pavilion, incorporating an umpire change room, function facilities, a kitchen and kiosk with an undercover viewing area at North Bendigo Recreation Reserve.

The project will deliver the upgrade the Central Deborah Gold Mine which includes a fully refurbished visitor centre, a refurbished artificial creek, new perimeter fencing, relocated video safety briefing room and design development for stage 2 works.

The project will deliver the construction of a sports pavilion including change spaces, toilet facilities, kiosk, club social rooms, covered outdoor area and storage areas, landscaping and pedestrian paths.

The project will deliver an upgrade of the River Heads barge landing by demolishing the current barge landing ramp and replacing with a new 8-metre-wide barge landing ramp to improve capacity and safety issues for passengers and vehicles.

The project will deliver the design and upgrade of the Ellenbrook Open Space North Building Pavilion. The project includes construction of a new function building, and upgrades to the existing pavilion.
The project will deliver the design and construction of new facilities at the South Beach Dog Beach including accessible toilets, and path networks.
The project will deliver a new 2-storey Tea Tree Gully Sporting Club Room. This will include four unisex changerooms, an umpire room, medical rooms and an undercover viewing area.
The project will deliver new amenities at Greta Central Oval including change rooms, canteen, and first aid.

The project will deliver a synthetic hockey pitch and associated infrastructure at the Hume Hockey Centre including; new lighting, player shelters and benches, fencing, netting, storage and landscaping.
The project will deliver upgrades of Linear Park at each Capital Works Site - Windsor Grove Reserve, Beefacres Reserve, Ramsey Reserve, Linear Park Lighting and OG Pedestrian Boardwalk.

The project will deliver the upgrade of Black Gully Linear Reserve and Captain Cook Reserve, including lighting, pathways and furnishings, new play items, disc golf course, new accessible toilet and construction of a new dog park.
The project will deliver the construction and fitout of a ground floor and first floor extension including players' change rooms, kiosk and bar, storage rooms and timekeeping and trainers office.
The project will deliver an upgrade to the bowling facility which includes installation of all-weather PVC membrane dome, new synthetic bowling green, canopy lighting, scoreboard and tiered seating.
The project will deliver an asphalt pump track integrated with a skate park to create a multi-disciplinary public space.

The project will deliver critical repairs and upgrades of community recreational infrastructure at David Madew Memorial Park in the suburb of Jerrabomberra, including a new playground and repairs to the tennis courts.
The project will deliver a fully operational café including commercial kitchen fit-out with indoor and outdoor seating. Landscaping and accessible footpaths.
The project will deliver the upgrade of the Kumbartcho Sanctuary, including construction of a new amenities building, storage shed and café, and upgrades to the carpark and playground.

The project will upgrade the Queanbeyan Bowls Club through the installation of an all-weather canopy, security fencing and lighting, and improvements to concrete pathways, spectator seating and stormwater infrastructure.

The project will deliver a full pitch replacement of the Carter Field at the National Hockey Centre in Lyneham, including a new International Category 1 surface, along with upgrades to the irrigation and fencing.
The project will deliver an upgrade to the Don Wallace Recreation Reserve, including the design and construction of a new female-friendly change facility and upgrades to the existing social pavilion.
The project will deliver upgrades to the Yulunga Reserve Playspace, including new inclusive play equipment, upgraded pathway lighting, and accessible pathways.
The project will deliver upgraded surface drainage, irrigation system, turfing and fencing at Edwin Flack Reserve.

The project will deliver upgrades to the Monash Aquatic and Recreation Centre, including construction of a fit-for-purpose outdoor change pavilion, accessible connecting pathways, and supporting infrastructure upgrades for future expansion.
The project will deliver a new purpose-designed, state of the art Emergency Services base and training facility for Volunteer Marine Rescue NSW.
The project will deliver the design and upgrade of North-West Tasmania's Shared Coastal Pathway Network.
The project will deliver upgraded recreation facilities across three reserves in Emu Plains and Emu Heights, including revitalised playgrounds, a resurfaced multi-sport court and accessible pathways.

The project will deliver the design and construction of Stage 1 including two new play areas with a rural-themed and nature-based playground, extension of the carpark, installation of a new building with toilets.
The project will deliver upgraded lighting at Carmichael Park, Bill Albury Oval and Ian Droney Oval including installation of electrical switchboards and new lighting poles.
The project will deliver the design and construction of the Grovedale Football Netball Club Burdoo Reserve Facility Upgrade, including two new netball courts and supporting infrastructure.
The project will deliver the design and construction of a new sporting pavilion at Truscott Recreation Reserve with new player amenities, change rooms and community facilities.

The project will deliver upgrades to stadium internal lighting, electrical board and roof rectification work, replacement of hot water system, resurfacing of indoor courts and installation of solar panels, heating, ventilation and air conditioning.
The project will deliver the installation of playground equipment including picnic tables, benches, BBQ, drink fountain, bike racks, landscaping.
The project will deliver upgraded sports field lighting at Water Board Oval in Blackalls Park, NSW.
The project will deliver the construction of an additional level on top of the existing single-story building including function room, amenities, air conditioning, lift, security and PA systems.
grants.rn: The Council of the Municipality of Kiama

grants.n: The project will deliver comprehensive electrical upgrades at Boronia Park including a new substation, solar panels and battery, along with upgraded sports lighting, and improvements to support EV chargers, air conditioning, and digital scoreboards.

The project will upgrade the existing Pambula Village and George Street Reserve local playspaces. Work will include installation of contemporary and nature-based play equipment, pathways, seating and associated landscaping and amenities.
The project will deliver the design and construction of in-ground and above-ground services infrastructure at Woody Point Foreshore.
This project will deliver changerooms with amenities and new lighting poles and lighting control system.
The project will deliver the installation of sports flood lights on new poles at Field 1 and 3 and raise existing pole footings at Field 2.
The project will deliver upgrades to existing light poles at Lionheart Reserve, and installation of new poles at Keilor Recreation Reserve.
The project will deliver lighting upgrades to three fields at Taylors Park, including improved electrical capacity, and installation of new poles with LED fittings.
The project will deliver upgraded facilities at Buff Point Oval.
The project will deliver the upgrade of lighting to the netball courts and upgrade the switchboard.
The project will deliver the construction of a single-storey senior citizens' club room, adjacent to the existing Picnic Point Hall in Bairnsdale, including kitchen and meeting facilities.
The project will deliver a new, inclusive nature and waterplay facility including walking paths, playgrounds and picnic facilities.
The project will deliver lighting upgrades at the John Balcomb Fields located in Dudley.
The project will deliver fencing and netting infrastructure upgrades at David Campese Oval, Queanbeyan NSW.
The project will deliver upgrades to the sports field lighting at Lyall Peacock Field in Toronto, NSW.
This project will deliver LED sports field floodlighting at Fotheringham Reserve soccer field in line with Australian Standards.
The project will deliver upgraded drainage and re-level the sporting field at Douglass Street Fields.
The project will deliver new lighting over four tennis courts at Rathmines Tennis Courts.
The project will deliver upgraded drainage to the sporting field at Bernie Goodwin Oval.
The project will deliver the design and construction of new lighting poles and lighting to the Cardiff Netball courts.
The project will deliver flood lights at Jack Edwards Oval, Argenton, NSW
The project will deliver the design and upgrade of outdated lighting at Southern Road Reserve to modern, energy efficient LED sports lighting.
The project will deliver the fit out for the mezzanine level of the existing pavilion with dedicated function, meeting and office space at Narre Warren Football Netball Club.
The project will deliver upgrade drainage at the Hunter Barnett Fields in Windale, NSW.
The project will deliver upgrades to the kiln room, workroom, kitchenette and gallery, roof repair and ceiling installation and external access and painting.

The project will deliver the upgrades at Whittlesea Showgrounds by replacing existing light towers and installing new sports field lighting at the oval and resurfacing the netball courts in the Chandler Pavilion.
grants.rn: Whittlesea Showgrounds and Recreation Reserves Committee of Management

grants.n: The project will deliver an upgrade to the paved steps at Charlestown Netball Courts in front of court 15 and 16, including construction of tiered concrete seating.
The project will deliver the installation of a solar power system and battery storage including solar panels, inverters, concrete platform and smart meter.
The project will deliver the design and construction of a secure perimeter fence along the Noella Place frontage of Halekulani Oval, including the installation of controlled inclusive access gates.
